assembly_info.comments:
Fundulus heteroclitus Sequence Assembly Release Notes
The killifish DNA for shotgun sequencing, is derived from a single female (Fundulus heteroclitus, sample id: Maine) from the laboratory of Dr. Doug Crawford, University of Miami, Miami, FL. This fish is from a wild population (43 deg 57' 14.27'' N 69 deg 43' 15.39'' W) and thus outbred with mean heterozygosity of approximately 0.10. All sequences were generated on the Illumina HiSeq 2000 instrument.
Total sequence coverage of Illumina instrument reads was
85X (fragments, 3, 8 and 40kb) using a genome size estimate of 1.4Gb. The combined sequence reads were assembled using the ALLPATHS software (Broad Institute). This draft assembly was referred to as Killifish 3.0.2. This version has been gap filled and cleaned of contaminating contigs. The assembly is made up of a total of 10,179 scaffolds with an N50 scaffold length of over 1.2Mb (N50 contig length was 16.7kb). The assembly spans 1.14Gb (with gaps).
***********************************************************************************

Fundulus heteroclitus Sequence and Assembly Credits
